description: Derived from AGSC-01-21: `tags.allowed` is the closed tag vocabulary, and a tag outside it MUST be reported as AGSC-E203, which section 9.4 registers as an error. The minimal fixture's configuration allows `agents` and `patterns`, and its lint reports nothing. One concept is added that conforms in every key, is a member of the fixture's cluster and carries two tags, so the 2-5 count of the section 2.2 table (the warning AGSC-E213) is met: `agents`, which is allowed, and `unlisted`, which is not. The whole list `lint` reports is one AGSC-E203 error naming that file and item, and lint exits 1 (AGSC-09-08). The allowed tag beside it raises nothing.
